# Website Accessibility Audit Service

## Purpose
Scope an accessibility review that gives a client actionable findings rather than an unsupported compliance certificate.

## Workflow
1. Confirm the public URL or client-authorized sample and define page templates and user journeys.
2. Record audit scope, browser, assistive-technology coverage, tools, versions, and test date.
3. Review semantic structure, headings, landmarks, labels, keyboard operation, focus visibility, contrast, zoom, and alternative text.
4. Test representative flows manually where possible; distinguish automated findings from human evaluation.
5. Record each issue with page, component, reproduction steps, impact, evidence, and confidence.
6. Map findings to relevant WCAG success criteria without claiming legal compliance.
7. Prioritize remediation and define a retest plan with measurable acceptance checks.

## Output
Scope, coverage matrix, issue register, evidence log, priority recommendations, and retest checklist.

## Safety and limits
- Public read-only inspection or client-authorized samples only.
- Do not submit forms, create accounts, or alter production content.
- Do not issue legal or formal conformance certification.
- No runtime activation or tool grants.

## Provenance
CEOAI-authored workflow. Audit planning and reporting only.
